proposal.description: The half-period is halved a second time (as if LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS were the full period), so the blink square wave toggles every quarter of the intended period and runs at 8 Hz
proposal.reason: While strike_level is non-zero and no latch is set, Red_LED1 toggles every LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS/2 clocks instead of every LED_BLINK_HALF_CLKS clocks.

proposal.description: Blink timebase only advances while strikes are outstanding and is frozen (not cleared) otherwise, so it is no longer free-running and keeps its phase from one strike episode to the next
proposal.reason: When strikes appear, the Red_LED1 blink starts from wherever the counter stopped (counter 0 after reset, or the remainder left by the previous episode), not at the free-running phase. Its edges come at different clocks from the intended design.

proposal.description: Over-temperature indicator is shown only while the converter is soft-starting or running, so an OTP that holds the converter off in S_OFF or S_HICCUP leaves Red_LED2 dark
proposal.reason: With otp_state high while neither ss_active nor run_active is set, which is the normal case during a thermal shutdown, Red_LED2 is 0 instead of 1.

proposal.description: Over-temperature indicator is cleared only when the converter is back in S_RUN, treating it as a thermal-shutdown history to keep until restart, instead of showing the live OTP condition
proposal.reason: After otp_state falls while the converter is in S_OFF, S_HICCUP or S_SS, Red_LED2 stays lit until run_active rises, though the board is no longer too hot.

proposal.description: Undervoltage indicator is made a brown-out history bit, set by UVLO and cleared only by reset, instead of following the live input-undervoltage condition
proposal.reason: After any uvlo_state pulse, Red_LED3 stays at 1 after the input recovers and until rst_n, instead of going back to 0 one clock after uvlo_state falls.
